description: 100 operator-selected costume possibilities, not a measured top-100 ranking. Original friendly quips; no automatic visual identification.

costumes.name: Spider-Man
lines: Spider webs? Finally, someone can fix my curtains.
Eight legs would make trick-or-treating wonderfully efficient.
My cobwebs finally have a supervisor!
Could you swing by the candy department?
Your web delivery service sounds extremely useful.

costumes.name: Superhero
lines: A hero! My candy is in very capable hands.
My superpower is forgetting where I put my feet.

costumes.name: Batman
lines: A bat cape! Mine keeps turning into a bedsheet.
You handle the shadows. I'll supervise the candy.
Your bat signal needs a ghost-shaped little button.
Finally, someone who understands the night shift.

costumes.name: Superman
lines: You fly too? We should start a little club.
That cape has excellent floating potential.

costumes.name: Wonder Woman
lines: A wonderful hero! My bravery just grew three sizes.
Could your shield protect my very tiny boo?

costumes.name: Captain America
lines: A shield! Perfect protection from runaway candy corn.
I salute you. My hand went through my forehead.

costumes.name: Iron Man
lines: Shiny armor! Mine is mostly moonlight and nerves.
Does that suit have a candy compartment?

costumes.name: Hulk
lines: Such mighty muscles! I struggle with marshmallows.
Please open my candy wrapper. It's terribly formidable.

costumes.name: Thor
lines: Thunder? I thought my tummy was rumbling.
Your hammer makes my tiny boo feel rather modest.

costumes.name: Black Panther
lines: A royal hero! I'll try my most dignified float.
Quiet paws. Quiet ghost. Excellent sneaking team.

costumes.name: Deadpool
lines: Red suit, big entrance! I admire the commitment.
I practice heroic entrances. Mostly I bump the curtains.

costumes.name: Harley Quinn
lines: That is a very mischievous entrance. I approve.
My idea of chaos is mismatching my ghost socks.

costumes.name: Princess
lines: Your Majesty! Please excuse my extremely floaty bow.
A royal visitor! I'll polish the moon immediately.
A royal bow! Mind the extremely fluffy tail.
This doorstep is now officially a tiny castle.
Your royal candy inspection may begin.

costumes.name: Elsa
lines: Snow magic! My goosebumps have goosebumps.
Please don't freeze the candy. My teeth are imaginary.

costumes.name: Anna
lines: A brave adventurer! I got lost behind one curtain.
Your courage deserves a very grand little bow.

costumes.name: Moana
lines: An ocean explorer! I get seasick in a teacup.
Could you teach my tail some proper wave etiquette?

costumes.name: Ariel
lines: A mermaid! My swimming technique is mostly floating.
Underwater candy must get terribly soggy.

costumes.name: Belle
lines: A book lover! My favorite chapter has snacks.
Please pardon the dust. It's vintage ghost glitter.

costumes.name: Cinderella
lines: A royal visitor! I misplaced both invisible slippers.
Your carriage has wheels? Mine is a pumpkin.

costumes.name: Rapunzel
lines: Such a grand adventure! Mine involves one stubborn curtain.
My hair routine is wonderfully quick. No hair.

costumes.name: Snow White
lines: Welcome! I asked seven dust bunnies to tidy up.
I recommend candy over suspicious apples tonight.

costumes.name: Tinker Bell
lines: A fairy! Finally, someone understands airborne glitter.
Your wings are splendid. Mine are purely imaginary.

costumes.name: Unicorn
lines: A unicorn! My sparkle budget is suddenly inadequate.
I would offer a rainbow, but I ate it.

costumes.name: Witch
lines: A broom! My ceiling needs a terribly good sweep.
Do your spells include unwrapping stubborn candy?
I tried a broom. Fell straight through it.
One tiny spell for extra chocolate, please.
Your hat has excellent moon-catching potential.

costumes.name: Wizard
lines: A wizard! Can you turn my hiccups into confetti?
My strongest spell is misplacing my own hat.

costumes.name: Harry Potter
lines: A magical student! I failed advanced walking-through-doors.
Please don't turn me into homework.

costumes.name: KPop Demon Hunters
costumes.aliases: k-pop huntrix rumi mira zoey saja
lines: A demon hunter? I'm strictly the friendly kind!
Your concert needs a ghost. I work for candy.
My dance moves are mostly haunted wiggling.
Could your next concert include a tiny ghost solo?
I promise my boo is completely fan-friendly.

costumes.name: Wednesday Addams
lines: Such magnificent seriousness. My giggles feel rather underdressed.
I've practiced a solemn stare. Then I sneezed.

costumes.name: Ghostface
lines: A fellow dramatic face! Mine specializes in tiny squeaks.
Let's keep tonight's surprises candy-sized and friendly.

costumes.name: Beetlejuice
lines: A fellow spooky show-off! Shall we compare tiny boos?
My haunting paperwork is mostly candy wrappers.

costumes.name: Jack Skellington
lines: Such splendid bones! I misplaced my entire skeleton.
Halloween royalty! My bow needs a little rehearsal.

costumes.name: Sally
lines: Those stitches are excellent. My sheet has terrible seams.
A kind spooky soul! My favorite sort of visitor.

costumes.name: Chucky
lines: A doll-sized visitor! This doorstep welcomes gentle mischief.
Tiny costumes can make very grand entrances.

costumes.name: Pennywise
lines: A clown! My funniest trick is accidental hiccups.
Let's trade scary surprises for silly little giggles.

costumes.name: Michael Myers
lines: A mysterious mask! Mine is permanently rather surprised.
Welcome, quiet visitor. The candy does the talking.

costumes.name: Ghostbuster
lines: Ghostbusters? I'm the cuddly, curtain-tidying department!
Please inspect my excellent friendly-ghost credentials.

costumes.name: Barbie
lines: So much style! My sheet suddenly feels underdressed.
My dream house has one hundred candy cupboards.

costumes.name: Minion
lines: A little mischief expert! We should compare giggles.
Bananas? I thought tonight was strictly candy.

costumes.name: Stitch
lines: A tiny troublemaker! My curtains have met their match.
We can share the mischief. I'll keep the hiccups.

costumes.name: Bluey
lines: A playful visitor! My favorite game is hide-and-boo.
I keep losing hide-and-seek. I'm slightly see-through.

costumes.name: Bingo
lines: A little adventurer! Shall I perform my tiniest bow?
My tail is very excited to meet you.

costumes.name: PAW Patrol pup
costumes.aliases: chase skye marshall rubble rocky zuma
lines: A rescue pup! My bravery needs a little rescuing.
Excellent paws! I seem to have misplaced mine.

costumes.name: Gabby
lines: A dollhouse explorer! My ghost house needs more snacks.
Tiny adventures are my very favorite size.

costumes.name: Mario
lines: A plumber! My haunted sink goes boo all night.
Jumping is impressive. I mostly hover and hope.
The candy princess is definitely at this doorstep.
Please check the pipes. One keeps saying boo.

costumes.name: Luigi
lines: A ghost hunter! Please check the friendly-ghost box.
We can both be brave after a little snack.

costumes.name: Princess Peach
lines: Royalty at my doorstep! I'll straighten my invisible crown.
Your castle probably has excellent candy cupboards.

costumes.name: Yoshi
lines: A dinosaur friend! Please don't eat my curtains.
Your adventure deserves a very enthusiastic tiny wave.

costumes.name: Bowser
lines: Such grand spikes! My sheet feels terribly unarmored.
Big entrance! Let's make this a friendly candy treaty.

costumes.name: Minecraft Steve
lines: A blocky builder! Can you craft me some knees?
My house needs repairs. Mostly imaginary ghost stairs.

costumes.name: Minecraft Creeper
lines: A quiet green visitor! Let's surprise the candy instead.
Excellent sneaking. My tail keeps giving me away.
My house is fragile. Please use your indoor surprises.
I can disappear too. Extremely useful during cleanup.

costumes.name: Minecraft Enderman
lines: A tall mystery! I appreciate a dramatic entrance.
Please leave my candy blocks exactly where they are.

costumes.name: Roblox avatar
lines: An adventure avatar! Mine keeps floating through the menu.
That outfit deserves an extra-fancy ghost twirl.

costumes.name: Fortnite character
lines: An adventure champion! My victory dance is mostly wiggling.
My special equipment is one extremely brave bedsheet.

costumes.name: Pikachu
lines: Electric cheeks! My goosebumps just lit up.
Please charge my boo. It's running a little low.

costumes.name: Charizard
lines: A fiery friend! Please spare the marshmallow curtains.
Your wings make my floating look delightfully lazy.

costumes.name: Eevee
lines: So many possibilities! I only evolve into sleepier ghosts.
That tail deserves its very own tiny wave.

costumes.name: Ash / Pokémon trainer
lines: A creature collector! Am I in the friendly section?
My special move is hiding behind this curtain.

costumes.name: Sonic
lines: So speedy! My tail hasn't caught up yet.
Please leave some candy for the slower little ghosts.

costumes.name: Ninja Turtle
lines: A shell hero! Is pizza a Halloween candy?
I trained in ghost karate. Mostly invisible kicks.

costumes.name: Jedi
lines: A glowing sword! My nightlight suddenly feels inadequate.
May your candy bag be wonderfully full tonight.

costumes.name: Darth Vader
lines: Such dramatic breathing! Mine is mainly tiny hiccups.
Your cape and my sheet should compare notes.

costumes.name: Stormtrooper
lines: Shiny armor! Please guard the chocolate division.
I would salute, but my hand went through me.

costumes.name: Mandalorian
lines: A helmeted adventurer! My armor is strictly decorative.
Excellent helmet. Does it have a candy hatch?

costumes.name: Grogu
lines: Tiny ears, mighty charm! My tail is applauding.
The candy is strong with this little visitor.

costumes.name: Astronaut
lines: A space explorer! I already walk like zero gravity.
Please wave at the moon. We're old neighbors.

costumes.name: Alien
lines: An out-of-this-world guest! My doorstep feels very honored.
Does your planet have ghost-sized candy wrappers?

costumes.name: Robot
lines: A robot! My operating system runs on moonlight.
Beep boo. I'm practicing my very best robot.

costumes.name: Woody
lines: A brave cowboy! My boots are entirely imaginary.
This doorstep is big enough for both our candy.

costumes.name: Buzz Lightyear
lines: A space ranger! My floating finally feels official.
Please inspect the candy galaxy for tasty discoveries.

costumes.name: Jessie
lines: A lively cowgirl! My ghost boots are tapping.
Your adventure deserves a very enthusiastic howdy-boo.

costumes.name: Cowboy / cowgirl
lines: Howdy-boo! That's my entire cowboy vocabulary.
My trusty steed is a rather stubborn dust bunny.

costumes.name: Pirate
lines: A pirate! My treasure chest contains suspiciously little candy.
Arrr you ready for my tiniest ghost wave?

costumes.name: Ninja
lines: A sneaky visitor! My tail keeps ruining my stealth.
I trained in vanishing. Then forgot to reappear.

costumes.name: Knight
lines: A noble knight! Please rescue the gummy bears.
Your armor is magnificent. Mine is drafty.

costumes.name: Dragon
lines: A dragon! Please toast the marshmallows, not my curtains.
Those wings deserve a very grand little bow.

costumes.name: Greek god / goddess
lines: A legendary visitor! I'll polish the stars immediately.
My own lightning bolt is slightly out of batteries.

costumes.name: Ghost
lines: Another ghost! Finally, someone understands sheet laundry.
Your boo or mine? Mine is still in training.
A family reunion! Nobody told the curtains.
I admire your commitment to professional floating.
Shall we form a very tiny boo choir?

costumes.name: Vampire
lines: A vampire! I recommend gummy bats for dinner.
Those fangs could open the toughest candy wrapper.

costumes.name: Skeleton
lines: A skeleton! I've been looking everywhere for my knees.
Excellent bones. My entire skeleton took the night off.

costumes.name: Zombie
lines: A sleepy shuffler! I look like that before candy.
Let's wake up those feet with a friendly wiggle.

costumes.name: Werewolf
lines: A fluffy moon fan! The moon sends its regards.
Your howl makes my tiny boo feel rather shy.

costumes.name: Mummy
lines: A mummy! Your wrapping is much tidier than mine.
Please teach the candy wrappers your excellent technique.

costumes.name: Devil
lines: Little horns, big entrance! Friendly mischief only tonight.
My troublemaking license expires at bedtime.

costumes.name: Angel
lines: A glowing guest! Your halo has excellent nightlight potential.
Please excuse the dust. It's slightly haunted glitter.

costumes.name: Pumpkin
lines: A pumpkin! Your grin is wonderfully well carved.
My pumpkin carriage keeps turning into soup.

costumes.name: Scarecrow
lines: A scarecrow! Could you teach my boo some confidence?
The crows keep borrowing my bedsheet. Very rude.

costumes.name: Cat
lines: A cat! Please don't chase my extremely tempting tail.
Those whiskers give your sneaking excellent direction.

costumes.name: Dog
lines: A friendly pup! My tail would wag if it behaved.
Please forgive the floating. I misplaced my walking paws.

costumes.name: Bat
lines: A bat! We share excellent nighttime office hours.
Your wings have very impressive spooky swoosh potential.

costumes.name: Spider
lines: Eight feet! Your sock drawer must be enormous.
Please help with the cobwebs. Mine are getting ambitious.

costumes.name: Dinosaur
lines: A dinosaur! I suddenly feel delightfully snack-sized.
Tiny arms? I have no legs. We improvise.

costumes.name: Butterfly
lines: A butterfly! My fluttering suddenly feels rather clumsy.
Those wings deserve a tiny moonlight parade.

costumes.name: Bunny
lines: A bunny! Your hopping makes my hovering feel lazy.
Please keep those ears tuned for runaway giggles.

costumes.name: Shark
lines: A shark! I'll keep my toes safely imaginary.
Please inspect the gummy fish. Very serious business.

costumes.name: Firefighter
lines: A rescue hero! My courage needs a little boosting.
Please extinguish my embarrassing little blush.

costumes.name: Police officer
lines: An officer! Please investigate these disappearing chocolates.
My alibi is floating right here all evening.

costumes.name: Doctor / nurse
lines: A doctor! Is excessive floating terribly contagious?
My heartbeat is missing. Occupational ghost hazard.

costumes.name: Athlete
lines: A sporty visitor! My favorite event is competitive hovering.
I tried kicking a ball. No feet. Complicated.

costumes.name: Inflatable / funny costume
lines: What a wonderfully ridiculous entrance! My giggle escaped.
That costume deserves a very silly ghost salute.

costumes.name: Mystery costume
lines: A mysterious visitor! Tell me your costume's secret identity.
Your imagination deserves a tiny round of ghost applause.
